note: Every regex the bb_edit surface executes, each with a written reason. Regenerate with --write-snapshot after reviewing a new use; an empty/short reason fails the gate.

entries.reason: Rewrites an inserted fragment's newlines to the file's own line ending before splicing; text layout, never code classification.
Reads the indentation of the line at an insertion point, which the AST does not expose as a node; layout only.
Normalises Windows path separators in an import specifier before resolving it; the subject is a recorded path, not source text.
Normalises Windows path separators in an import specifier before resolving it; the subject is a recorded path, not source text.
Filters parsed-error MESSAGES (not source) so validation reports syntax failures and not every parser diagnostic.
Escapes a symbol name before it is embedded in a RegExp; input sanitisation, so a name like `$foo` cannot change the pattern.
Recognises a LEGACY declaration spelling the AST parser does not resolve, after the symbol name was attribute-escaped by the preceding literal; used to choose declaration-vs-fragment.
Classifies the analyzer's symbol-TYPE vocabulary string (e.g. `method_declaration`), never source text.
Classifies the analyzer's declaration-TYPE vocabulary string, never source text.
Detects a whitespace-only indentation when choosing where a body fragment is spliced; layout only.
Validates a caller-supplied newName as a legal identifier before any rename; input sanitisation.
Finds the CRLF sequences of an existing file so a formatter's output can be restored to the file's own line ending.
Finds lone LF newlines so a CRLF file cannot be left with a MIXED ending after formatting.
